title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(林亮子研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Hayashi Ryoko)
educationalGoal: Based on the concrete knowledge of fundamental technology, students acquire problem-solving skills related to computer & information engineering. Students are also given opportunities to experience R&D activities related to concrete information technology and systems. Through this process, students cultivate advanced abilities in the areas of problem setting, production process development, information gathering, communications, problem-solving in regional orientation, and making objective evaluations.
advice: Simulation technology has evolved as the third tool for R&D for modern fields of science and technology, and data science technology is seen as taking its place as the fourth R&D tool in recent years. In this course, students will be exposed to laboratory research covering a wide range of areas including chemistry, physics, and aeronautical engineering. Some of the actual contents of research conducted in this laboratory are as follows. 1. Fireworks design systems, as seen from the viewpoint of particle movement simulations. 2. KIT Guidance systems, as an application of computer graphics, database skill, etc. 3. Research into origami airplanes via data mining. 4. VR systems as real-world simulation systems. 5. High-performance computing.
requiredKnowledge: Research guidance policy In this laboratory, seminars by students and faculty members are conducted once a week. Students are expected to set themes, summarize survey analysis results, and discover social problems, as well as prepare for annual events such as writing academic papers and making conference presentations. Additionally, using multiple networked PCs, students explore robot technology, embedded system technology, cloud technology, network technology, image processing technology, etc.

activityGoals.body: Be able to set one-year achievement goals in relation to your chosen research.
Be able to set a specific production approach based on your set research concept.
Be able to use your acquired information engineering expertise to advance your design and analysis efforts.
Be able to cope with various problems that occur during the design and analysis process.
Be able to technically describe what you have accomplished in a convincing manner.

achievementLevels.ideal: Be able to promote R&D activities smoothly according to the project plan (proposal) that you have created. In the results, it is desirable that students be able to announce concrete results that are scientifically and/or technically recognized as novel, effective, and reliable.
achievementLevels.standard: Be able to promote R&D activities smoothly according to the project plan (proposal) that you have created. In the results, it is desirable that students be able to announce concrete results that are based in scientific and technical reality.

lessons.content: Progress reports and study sessions are held every week.
